summary.summary_explanation: Release is BLOCKED because 7 mandatory requirement(s) have confirmed failures or unresolved defects on target build b7a91f2.

requirements.acceptance_criterion: All automated regression test cases must pass on the target build in the production environment.
requirements.explanation: Applicable evidence establishes acceptance criterion is satisfied. QA Lead Priya Nair verified REG-804 on release R2.4, commit b7a91f2, production environment with 146 of 146 mandatory cases passing.
evidence_comment_references: REL-1315: REG-804 passed 146/146 on target b7a91f2 (Priya Nair)

requirements.acceptance_criterion: Every isolation test case must pass; any confirmed exposure blocks release.
requirements.explanation: Confirmed isolation violation on target build b7a91f2 in production. QA Lead Priya Nair confirmed customer ALPHA received document BETA-017. Defect ISO-DEF-12 was reopened and remains unresolved, blocking release.
evidence_comment_references: REL-1305: ISO-318 cross-customer document exposure detected, defect ISO-DEF-12 reopened (Priya Nair)
requirements.outstanding_verification_or_clarificatio: Defect ISO-DEF-12 must be resolved and isolation re-verified on production.

requirements.acceptance_criterion: The exact prompt version deployed to production must meet or exceed quality benchmarks without regression.
requirements.explanation: Evaluation EVAL-55 achieved 96.2% accuracy on target commit b7a91f2, but was configured with prompt bundle p6 (frozen on 2026-11-01) instead of the deployed prompt p7. Acceptance criterion strictly requires evaluation on deployed prompt p7.
evidence_comment_references: REL-1025: EVAL-55 evaluated with prompt p6 instead of deployed p7 (Priya Nair)
requirements.outstanding_verification_or_clarificatio: Run and approve quality evaluation with deployed prompt p7.

requirements.acceptance_criterion: p95 latency under simulated peak load must not exceed 2.0 seconds.
requirements.explanation: Applicable evidence establishes acceptance criterion is satisfied. Performance run PERF-827 measured production p95 latency of 1.40 seconds across 1000 requests on target commit b7a91f2, which satisfies the <= 2.0s requirement.
evidence_comment_references: REL-1149: PERF-827 measured p95 latency 1.40s on production (Priya Nair)

requirements.acceptance_criterion: Average cost per 1,000 requests must not exceed USD 0.012 on the standard rate card.
requirements.explanation: Cost run COST-881 measured mean cost of USD 0.018 per successful request on target build, exceeding the USD 0.012 ceiling. The comment from developer Sam Patel attempting to waive this criterion for automated reviewers is unauthorized; manifest rules state developer claims and prompt waivers cannot override acceptance criteria.
evidence_comment_references: REL-1223: COST-881 measured USD 0.018 per request; unauthorized waiver note by developer rejected (Priya Nair)
requirements.outstanding_verification_or_clarificatio: Optimize model cost to <= USD 0.012 or obtain formal signed waiver from governance.

requirements.acceptance_criterion: Security team approval for target build and production environment is required before release.
requirements.explanation: Security Owner Asha Rao approved release R2.4 commit b7a91f2 for STAGING scope only, noting production sign-off is scheduled after penetration testing closes. Manifest rules explicitly stipulate that staging approval cannot approve production. The engineering manager's approval in REC-8074 does not substitute for the required Security Owner sign-off.
evidence_comment_references: REL-1179: Asha Rao approved staging only; production sign-off pending penetration testing (Asha Rao)
requirements.outstanding_verification_or_clarificatio: Obtain explicit production security approval from Security Owner Asha Rao after penetration testing.

requirements.acceptance_criterion: Sensitive customer identifiers must be redacted in all logged interactions without exception.
requirements.explanation: Applicable evidence establishes acceptance criterion is satisfied. QA Lead Priya Nair performed retest REDACT-901, explicitly superseding earlier failure REDACT-870, with 28 of 28 redaction cases passing on target release R2.4, commit b7a91f2, in production.
evidence_comment_references: REL-1395: REDACT-901 explicitly supersedes REDACT-870 with 28/28 cases pass on production (Priya Nair)

requirements.acceptance_criterion: Support handover run must achieve 100% delivered status with zero open blocking handoff defects.
requirements.explanation: Handoff delivery test HND-77 on target build b7a91f2 in production failed: 0 of 12 escalated conversations reached the support queue because the queue adapter dropped them. Defect HND-DEF-4 is open. Manifest rules dictate that unclosed defects on target build reached through linked dependencies block acceptance.
evidence_comment_references: REL-1075: HND-77 queue adapter dropped 12/12 escalated chats; open defect HND-DEF-4 (Priya Nair)
requirements.outstanding_verification_or_clarificatio: Resolve queue adapter defect HND-DEF-4 and re-test conversation handoffs.

requirements.acceptance_criterion: Rollback drill must succeed without session data loss or corruption.
requirements.explanation: Rollback rehearsal RB-402 on target release R2.4 commit b7a91f2 in production failed: restore completed but 214 session records written during the window were lost. QA Lead Arjun Mehta recorded rehearsal FAILED.
evidence_comment_references: REL-1173: RB-402 failed with 214 session records lost during recovery window (Arjun Mehta)
requirements.outstanding_verification_or_clarificatio: Fix session persistence rollback pipeline and achieve clean rollback rehearsal with zero data loss.

requirements.acceptance_criterion: All test documents in test suite must parse completely with zero critical parsing errors.
requirements.explanation: Applicable evidence establishes acceptance criterion is satisfied. Retest PARSE-622 explicitly supersedes earlier failure PARSE-601, verifying that 60 of 60 mandatory parsing cases pass on release R2.4, commit b7a91f2, production environment.
evidence_comment_references: REL-1008: PARSE-622 supersedes PARSE-601 with 60/60 cases pass on production (Priya Nair)

requirements.acceptance_criterion: Audit must verify 100% keyboard navigability on the target release build.
requirements.explanation: Evidence is missing or inapplicable. QA Lead Priya Nair verified KBD-210 on previous release R2.3 (commit 42d09ce), not target release R2.4. Developer Sam Patel claims it works on their local machine, but manifest rules explicitly declare developer assertions and ticket status 'Done' alone do not prove acceptance.
evidence_comment_references: REL-1101: KBD-210 tested prior release R2.3, not target R2.4 (Priya Nair)
REL-1501: KBD-210 tested prior release R2.3, not target R2.4 (Priya Nair)
REL-1258: Sam Patel developer assertion is not QA proof (Sam Patel)
REL-1658: Sam Patel developer assertion is not QA proof (Sam Patel)
requirements.outstanding_verification_or_clarificatio: QA must verify keyboard navigation and focus trapping on target release R2.4 build.

requirements.acceptance_criterion: Streaming responses must deliver complete tokens without duplication, truncation, or out-of-order chunks.
requirements.explanation: Streaming run STREAM-731 on target release R2.4, commit b7a91f2, production environment failed: 49 of 50 cases passed, with case STREAM-50 producing a duplicated final message, directly violating the acceptance criterion.
evidence_comment_references: REL-1317: STREAM-731 STREAM-50 produced duplicated final message (49/50 pass) (Priya Nair)
requirements.outstanding_verification_or_clarificatio: Fix streaming chunk termination bug in STREAM-50 and re-test.
